source: BroadSniff 0.3.0 on an RM4 Pro (VM999 bench, 2026-11-03): 0xB1 RF packets from an IT104 four-button 433.92 MHz keyfob (EV1527, address 0x950E4), as the receiver read them. Durations in microseconds, unsigned, mark first; the last value of each capture is the fixed tail.

presses.first: button 1, 2, 3 and ALL, three presses each, held for different lengths
